hypothesis: Constructing a whole noncrossing finite-width family from chord-depth boundary reservations removes repeated geometric per-wire search and rip-up in an obstacle-free cell.
mechanism: Arbitrary boundary pairing, fixed normal leads, collective boundary-arc depth counts, conservative axis-aligned inflated arc strips, visibility shortest paths, independent Euclidean clearance validation. No finite chord/elbow formula catalog.
domain: At least two two-terminal connections, one common layer, equal routing traceWidth, unique noncorner boundary ports, no physical obstacle in the expanded cell, board-contained cell. Alternating pairings, vias, obstacle cells and unsupported metrics dispatch to the original solver with explicit counters.
scene_composition: Full-scene normalized ports are indexed once. Candidates are deferred while all native cells finish. Final native and pending-family copper checks can invalidate tentative certificates and schedule their unchanged native solver; repeat until fixed point, then commit all remaining families. No output certificate survives an unchecked later native overhang.
scheduling_limit: Global scene certification uses serial HD scheduling, including solveAsync. The counter thickFamilySerialSceneScheduling discloses this; end-to-end Blacksmith elapsed time is primary.
width_limit: The constructor certifies routing traceWidth, as supplied to native HD too. Per-net nominal widening, simplification, length matching and independent final DRC remain downstream and unchanged; no claim that this is a variable-width simultaneous solver.
work_removed: Accepted committed families do not instantiate the regular HD node solver. Visibility and clearance predicates, deferred/invalidated/committed cells, indexed scene ports and constructed routes are phase stats.
falsifiers: Low committed coverage on expensive cells prevents 10x end-to-end improvement
Visibility/reservation setup or serial scene scheduling costs exceed removed HD work
Scene invalidations or downstream repairs consume the saved work
Any strict full-board quality regression rejects the implementation
validation: Three arbitrary nested/turning/through families: endpoint, width and all segment clearances
Foreign terminal, previous copper, rotated obstacle, concave outline, crossing and via exclusions
Phase integration proves zero regular-node calls for a committed family
Controlled later native overhang invalidates a pending certificate before commit
Existing P9 differential-pair pad-clearance regression passes
performance_claim: None before paired Blacksmith results. Cell coverage is not time-weighted coverage. A negative result applies only to this bounded conservative implementation.
